chunks: And if We had willed, We could have sent a warner into every town.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says God could have sent a warner to every town?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *Ikhtiyar* (divine choice) over *Qahr* (compulsion), illustrating that the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was selected not due to a lack of capacity to send multiple warners, but as a specific divine decree for universal guidance. This highlights the unique status of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt as the primary carriers of the message, reinforcing the concept that divine wisdom dictates the method of revelation rather than mere omnipotence.
